body.purpose: Questions, dated records, and explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Field labels, short section labels, and status captions.

motion.name: route-enter
motion.purpose: Brief route entry and assessment transitions; disabled for reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse animations and transitions and disable smooth scrolling.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary next step or save action, with a clear hover and keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #4E7660; border-radius: 12px; background: #4E7660; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #365B48; border-color: #365B48; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #89AA94; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action for adjacent or optional choices.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #D7E4DA; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24352B; font: 500 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #AFC6B5; background: #F7FAF8; color: #365B48; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #89AA94; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A labeled field for profile details and reflective notes.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="Your note" placeholder="Write a note" />
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #C8D8CD; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24352B; font: 400 16px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #89AA94; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #52645A; }

components.name: Record Card
components.description: A white, lightly outlined surface for dated observations.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #D7E4DA; border-radius: 18px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24352B; font: 400 16px/1.62 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #52645A; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A text-led status with a pale color pair; label carries the meaning.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 26px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #E9F3EB; color: #325D48; font: 600 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
CareCompass is a light, quiet place for an individual to record how they are doing and revisit dated observations. The visual voice is personal and grounded: clean white panels sit on a soft sage-tinted ground, while restrained green accents help people find the next step without making the interface feel clinical or urgent by default.

Use a clear app-scale hierarchy, readable explanatory copy, and small line icons only where they aid recognition. Results are screening categories and personal observations, never a diagnosis or a measure of progress. Keep support and safety language visible and plain. The palette is light-only; do not introduce a dark theme.
keyCharacteristics: Soft sage accents on clean white and ivory-green surfaces.
Dated, observational language for personal records and screening history.
Calm, concise next steps with safety guidance preserved.
One consistent inline SVG line-icon system; no emoji.
Short, purposeful route and assessment transitions that honor reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Observation Rule
rules.body: Color may distinguish status, but never imply that a screening category is a diagnosis or proof of personal progress.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Rule
rules.body: Screening labels and observations use accompanying plain-language context; typography must not create clinical authority the product does not have.

dos: Do use the light-only ivory, white, and sage surface system.
Do keep CareCompass safety, consent, privacy, and non-diagnostic language clear and intact.
Do describe history in dated, observational terms and compare result categories explicitly.
Do pair status colors with readable labels and keep calm next steps easy to find.
Do use one accessible inline SVG line-icon family and no emoji.
Do keep route and assessment motion short and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't use dark surfaces, emoji, or a second competing icon style.
Don't present categories as diagnoses, treatment advice, or evidence of progress.
Don't use color alone to communicate urgency, severity, selection, or validation.
Don't alter scoring, safety behavior, consent, persistence, or data handling through visual work.
